Pinaceae.key_door: fascicled needles + persistent sheath + woody free-scaled seed cone; P. echinata vs P. taeda by needle/fascicle/cone/bark suite

Ginkgoaceae.key_door: fan-shaped dichotomously veined leaf + spur shoots + stalked naked ovules/seeds; no seed cone

Ephedraceae.key_door: jointed green photosynthetic stems + tiny sheathing scale leaves + nodal compound cones; opposite vs 3-whorled leaf architecture separates project species

anchor_families.Cupressaceae: existing family module plus Joey Santore Juniperus virginiana scale-foliage frame

joey_private_anchor.policy: preferred private-study comparison asset; public reuse remains separate

taxonomy_notes: Pinus echinata and Pinus taeda remain accepted current species concepts and Kew includes Texas in their native ranges.
Ginkgo biloba remains accepted and is the sole living species of Ginkgo; current Kew native range is southeastern China.
Ephedra antisyphilitica and Ephedra trifurca remain accepted current species concepts and both include Texas in current native-range treatments.
Joey visual evidence is used for diagnostic comparison but does not replace species-level range review.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Do not call Ginkgo's fleshy seed coat a fruit.
Do not call juniper fleshy cones berries in the teaching layer.
Do not identify Pinus echinata vs P. taeda from one overlapping character.
Do not identify Ephedra species from shrub habit alone; use node leaf arrangement and cone-bract characters.
